title: lolium perenne var. italicum
intro: Lolium perenne var. italicum, commonly known as Italian ryegrass, is a perennial grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Italian ryegrass are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. These bioactive constituents contribute to its potential therapeutic applications in treating various health conditions, including bronchitis and asthma.
